title: Dragon Emerging from Painting
description: A woman in a purple and white bikini sits on a beige couch taking a selfie with her smartphone while a large dark dragon with glowing green eyes bursts through a torn canvas from a European street scene. The painting reveals a chaotic cobblestone street with burning buildings, smoke, and armored figures in the background.
prompt: A woman wearing a purple bikini top and white bikini bottom sits on a beige couch taking a selfie with her phone, a black and white patterned headscarf on her head. She is positioned inside a torn painting that reveals a fiery apocalyptic European cobblestone street with a massive dark dragon with glowing green eyes and sharp spines emerging from the canvas, flames and black smoke filling the background with burning buildings and distant figures.
